title: Tamsin gives an explicit last-warning line ('One more like that and I'm gone. I don't give second warnings, only first ones.') after I stole the smith's tongs; I immediately stole the chapel's blessed candles right after and she only says 'I'm starting to wonder why I'm still wasting it on you' with no regard change and no departure. The stated ultimatum has no teeth.
